rust_base_revision_note: the branch base of bundle/B3b-LM-FIDELITY. The 79 review inputs in review_problems.txt were generated by the B4-GAUSS round-2 review at df60a8ad5d9bbeb75f55c8e47a6df276994fc9e6, which is not an ancestor of this branch.
method: Differential of the Levenberg-Marquardt evaluation path. src/math/fitters/levenberg_marquardt.rs::minimize is driven with the GaussTraceFitter and EGHTraceFitter functors written out from the pinned source, on 141 trace fits, and its status, nfev, njev, final parameters and the bits of every residual-evaluation argument are compared with stock Eigen::LevenbergMarquardt as TraceFitter::optimize_ configures it, built twice: with the flags of the Linux x86_64 Release build of OpenMS and with those of the macOS arm64 product SDK, plus a third build with Eigen's arm64 FMA lanes disabled. The oracle's replica is checked against each platform's libOpenMS: its final parameters equal GaussTraceFitter::fit / EGHTraceFitter::fit in 141 of 141 fits on both.
evidence_tier: tier 1 (executed differential): the expectations are the output of stock Eigen linked against, and cross-checked with, the libraries themselves. The traced replica used to localise the divergence (lm_traced.h) is labelled adapted in the oracle manifest and is not what the fixture records.

context_sources.role: Eigen 5.0.1 minimizeInit/minimizeOneStep; byte-identical in the Homebrew (macOS) and conda-forge (Linux) installations both reference builds use
computeInPlace: column norms, pivoting, LAPACK downdating, rank threshold
makeHouseholder and applyHouseholderOnTheLeft, whose projection is a GemvProduct for a block and an InnerProduct for a vector
redux_impl<LinearVectorizedTraversal, NoUnrolling>, the two-lane sum reproduced as eigen_sum
inner_product_impl, the four-accumulator dot product reproduced as eigen_dot
EIGEN_SCALAR_MADD_USE_FMA, fixed before the FMA detection runs, which is why the scalar tails are unfused on both platforms
pmadd<Packet2d> = vfmaq_f64 when EIGEN_VECTORIZE_FMA is defined, which __ARM_FEATURE_FMA always defines on arm64

context_sources_note: Eigen 5.0.1 headers, cited for the arithmetic the port reproduces; none is ported. The sha256 values are those of both installations, which are byte-identical for every header on this path (run.sh compares them).

fixtures.role: the 79 GaussTraceFitter problems of the B4-GAUSS review, with the start vector from product-SDK setInitialParameters_
status, nfev, njev, final parameters, evaluation count, FNV-1a 64 digest of the evaluation path and the start residual norm, per oracle build and problem, plus the library fits

reused_fixtures.role: the 62 C2 trace-fit problems (traces, weights, start vectors); this group reads only the problem definitions, not the budget sweep

linux-x86_64-release.role: benchmark and production reference; the fixture's asserted oracle on Linux x86_64 glibc
linux-x86_64-release.toolchain: x86_64-conda-linux-gnu-c++ (conda-forge gcc 14.4.0-4) 14.4.0; ldd (Ubuntu GLIBC 2.39-0ubuntu8.9) 2.39; model name	: AMD EPYC 7763 64-Core Processor

macos-arm64-sdk.role: correctness oracle for macOS arm64; Eigen fuses its packet multiply-adds here, which the port deliberately does not model: the user decided on 2026-09-15 to match linux-x86_64-release on every target (docs/DISTRIBUTION_FITTERS_SUPPORT.md section 1)

macos-arm64-nofma.role: experiment, not a shipped configuration: the SDK configuration with __ARM_FEATURE_FMA hidden from Eigen; the fixture's asserted oracle on macOS arm64

oracle.environment: env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin HOME=<scratch>/home OPENMS_HOME_PATH=<scratch>/home OPENMS_DISABLE_UPDATE_CHECK=ON OPENMS_DATA_PATH=<sdk>/share/OpenMS/4.0.0, per-run cwd, perl alarm
oracle.debug_only: none: every record comes from a completed minimize
oracle.toolchain_note: The macOS stage was built with Apple clang 21.0.0 (clang-2100.1.1.101) from Xcode; re-running it with the Command Line Tools clang (clang-2100.3.34.2) reproduces results/macos/stock.out byte for byte.
oracle.manifest_note: manifest.json carries a created_utc stamp, so re-running make_manifest.py changes this hash; the file hashes it records do not.

comparison.asserted: bit equality of status, nfev, njev, every parameter of x and the FNV-1a 64 digest of every residual-evaluation argument, with NaN equal to NaN
comparison.linux_x86_64_release: 141 of 141 fits, measured on the gate node dax
comparison.macos_arm64_nofma: 141 of 141 fits, measured locally on macOS arm64
comparison.macos_arm64_sdk: 21 of 141 fits; the gap is Eigen's fused arm64 lanes and is measured by the ignored macos_arm64_sdk_gap_report
comparison.libm: the residuals call exp, so each expectation is asserted only on the platform whose libm the oracle linked (cfg(target_os/target_arch/target_env)); the start residual norm is compared first and reports a different libm as such

external_reference_note: No C++ is committed here. The driver, the traced Eigen replica, the written-out functors, the case table and the generators live under ../oracle/lm-eigen-path; their sha256 values are recorded so the fixture can be regenerated and audited, and ../oracle/lm-eigen-path/manifest.json hashes every build, result and Eigen header of both platforms.
target_verification: bash ../oracle/lm-eigen-path/run.sh  (regenerates both fixture files; every C++ mode runs twice and is byte-compared)
